about: The desktop version's software library (scripts/fetch-software.sh), as links: each archive stays where it is preserved, and the page applies the same rules when a visitor drops one in. Keep the two in step; web/smoke.mjs checks.

items.title: Zork I, II and III
items.note: Infocom's text adventures: run ZORK1, ZORK2 or ZORK3. Type plain English (OPEN MAILBOX, GO NORTH); SAVE and RESTORE work; QUIT leaves.

items.title: A collection of games
items.note: Colossal Cave (ADVENTUR), Infocom's Enchanter (ENCHANTE), OTHELLO, a Pac-Man chase (PACMAN95), and BASIC games such as Star Trek (MBASIC STAR.BAS, which needs MBASIC). Answer Y/N questions in capitals.

items.title: Ladder
items.note: Arcade climbing game; set Speed to 2 MHz. A up, Z down, comma left, period right, Space jumps.

items.title: Catchum
items.note: A Pac-Man clone. 1 for one player; A/Z up and down, comma/period left and right. Try 2 MHz.

items.title: Sargon chess
items.note: Answer the setup questions with a capital Y or N, then enter moves like E2E4.

items.title: Microsoft BASIC (MBASIC 5.29)
items.note: Type numbered lines, then RUN. Ctrl-C stops a program; SYSTEM returns to A>. Also runs the BASIC games: MBASIC STAR.BAS.

items.title: Turbo Pascal 3.01a
items.note: Run TURBO and answer N to "include error messages"; then the menu: Edit, Compile, Run.

items.title: BDS C 1.60
items.note: A C compiler, put in the public domain by its author: CC HELLO.C, then CLINK HELLO, then HELLO. Start with #include <STDIO.H>.

items.title: muLISP-80 and LISP/80
items.note: Run MULISP and type Lisp in CAPITALS at the $ prompt: (PLUS 2 3). (RDS DOCTOR LIB) loads Eliza. Ctrl-C exits.

items.title: Microsoft FORTRAN-80 3.43
items.note: F80 compiles a .FOR file and LINK links it into a .COM.

items.title: CBASIC (CB-80)
items.note: Digital Research's compiled BASIC: CB80 compiles and LK80 links.

items.title: WordStar 4
items.note: The word processor, installed for this screen automatically when you drop it in (it takes a few seconds). Run WS; ^KX saves and exits, ^KQ quits without saving.

items.title: dBASE II
items.note: Press Return at the date question; try ? "HELLO" at the . prompt; leave with QUIT (not Ctrl-C).

items.title: Microsoft Multiplan
items.note: A spreadsheet: run MP. Commands are the menu along the bottom; Quit from there.

items.title: SuperCalc
items.note: A spreadsheet: run SC. Not set up for a terminal, so it may not display correctly yet.
